::: {#sol-same-seed}

```{python}
#| code-fold: show
first, second = train_and_score(64, 0.1, 0), train_and_score(64, 0.1, 0)
print(first == second, first[-1])
print(torch.__version__)
assert first == second
```

Yes: all 20 validation [accuracies](https://morrison-lab.github.io/lds/chapters/metrics.html#def-accuracy) agree,
because each call reseeds both generators of @sol-random-draws before it draws anything.
That holds on one machine,
with one version of each library.
The printed `torch.__version__` is the PyTorch version that rendered this page.

:::
